column1: PM Modi-Trump G7 Meeting: Prime Minister Narendra Modi met U.S. President Donald Trump at the G7 Summit, discussing issues including sailor safety and the Iran peace process.
India-UK Trade Deal: India and the UK overcame a steel hurdle, scheduling the implementation of their bilateral trade deal for July 15.
NSE IPO Filing: The National Stock Exchange (NSE) filed a Draft Red Herring Prospectus for a massive ?30,000-crore IPO, set to be India's biggest public issue.
Massive Rural Infrastructure Expansion: The Centre is building 26,474 km of rural roads to boost remote connectivity and stimulate economic growth in villages.
Manipur Operations: Security forces intensified search operations in Manipur's Kangpokpi, seizing arms and destroying militant bunkers.
Record Defence Production: India's annual defence production recorded an all-time high of ?1.78 lakh crore for the 2025-26 fiscal year.
China Mega Dam Concerns: China's construction of a massive hydroelectric dam on the Brahmaputra River in Tibet, just 50km from the Indian border, sparked national security worries.
Deportation Figures: The Ministry of External Affairs reported that over 1,000 Indian nationals had been deported from the U.S. so far in 2026 due to illegal migration crackdowns.
TVK Policy Unveiled: Tamil Nadu Governor R. N. Arlekar outlined the policy roadmap of the new Vijay-led TVK government, focusing on caste surveys and anti-corruption drives.
